thread:
devon: FYI i'm switching shifts next week due to travel. need a clear plan for 2026-04-02 handoffs + two new shadow slots for on-call onboarding. thoughts on who covers primary/secondary? also we should run a short live shadow sim before handing folks their first solo shift.

oncall-bot: new rotation draft posted: https://intranet.redwood/oncall/rotations (auto)

maya: i can take primary for fri 08:00-16:00. liam can be secondary if he's available. reyna said she'd like to shadow a low-risk evening shift.

liam: i can be secondary for fri, and i'll take the 18:00-22:00 shadow shift on weds. prefer to shadow with ana as buddy if possible.

ana: (typo) ana: happy to buddy liam on weds. i also want a quick checklist we can pin during handoff — something tiny so folks remember runbook hits.

maya: short handoff checklist (put this in the meeting notes):
- confirm active alerts in https://ops.redwood/incidents (filter: service:redwood-runtime)
- check deploys: last 24h model/version changes (console > deploys)
- quick health: request 5 sample inferences, check p95 latency and gpu utilization
- cache: prefix/KV cache hit rate + recent evictions
- confirm contacts: secondary, infra, and customer-eng leads
- acknowledge any ongoing mitigations and update incident channel

devon: nice. for paging rules: SEV1/SEV2 -> page primary and secondary. SEV3 -> page channel but no immediate page unless repeated. sample PD trigger we use in scripts: 
```bash
# minimal example to trigger PD from scripts
curl -X POST 'https://api.pagerduty.com/incidents' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Authorization: Token token=REDACTED' \
  -d '{"incident": {"type": "incident", "title": "Token error spike - runtime", "service": {"id": "SVC123", "type": "service_reference"}}}'
```

incident-bot: alert RA-99002: sustained p95 latency > 1200ms for 10m on redwood-runtime - auto-signal. (no action taken yet)

liam: quick question 1 1: when shadowing, should shadows be able to acknowledge pages or only observe? i'd prefer they can acknowledge low-sev to practice.

maya: policy: shadows can acknowledge SEV3s and document steps. only buddy+primary can ack SEV2/SEV1. we should put that into onboarding notes.

reyna: i'm down to shadow fri evening (20:00-22:00) to see how pages look at low traffic. also can sit in the mock incident on thursday.

devon: proposing a short pre-shadow session: thursday 17:45 - 18:15. agenda: runbook quick tour, demo of paging flow (pd + slack), and a 5-min simulated page where the shadow triages. who can join?

ana: in for thursday.

liam: can join. can someone post the runbook link in this thread?

maya: runbook link: https://docs.redwood/runbooks/oncall-v2 (will update cache-check line to include exact prometheus query)

liam: one more thing: please remind new shadows to watch the KV cache dashboard and the prefix cache eviction alert. we've had multiple small incidents tied to cache evictions during heavy sampling tests.

devon: added to onboarding notes. also flag: weekend coverage gap 1 we're short a secondary next sunday 12:00-20:00 while reyna finishes training. can someone take backup for next two sundays?

maya: i can take next sunday secondary.

liam: i can cover the following sunday.

devon: great. i'll lock the rotation and ping #general about the temporary weekend coverage change so product & sales know.

incident-bot: incident RA-99002 resolved at 2026-04-01T18:05:12Z 1 mitigation: increased batching window, evicted stale cache entries, scaled cache nodes. no customer-facing errors recorded.

reyna: thanks everyone. i'll DM devon about pre-shadow pairing. excited to learn.

maya: invite for thursday 17:45 sent + calendar reminder. recording will be added to onboarding folder for folks who can't make it. :party_parrot:

devon: final note 1 please mark "shadow-pass" in the rotation spreadsheet when a shadow completes their simulated page. we want to track 2 successful shadows before assigning solo weekend duties. cheers and thanks for jumping in.
